about: What the app writes to the first mate when the captain answers a call (answer_message), replies to one (reply_message), or puts one off to a day (defer_message), as src-tauri/src/review.rs writes it. Its tests build each message and compare it with this file, and scripts/calls.test.mjs reads each back with answerOfMessage, so the two ends cannot drift apart.

answered.label: Keep merging once checks pass
answered.text:

replied.words: Pause it, and tell the user why.
replied.text:
The captain replied to call res-wifi-drop from Bearings, in words; it is kept on the call as the captain's reply, and nothing has recorded it.
Record one with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh answer only if the captain's words decide the call (with --key when they name one of its options, and --via quarterdeck); otherwise answer the captain and ask again with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh offer, or hold it with --until when the words put it off to a date. Never infer an answer from the words alone.
The captain said: Pause it, and tell the user why.

replied.words: Not now. Ask me again on Oct 3. I want to see the battery numbers first.

deferred.text:
The captain deferred call foreman-auto-merge from Bearings until 2026-10-03; bin/fm-captain-hold.sh defer has already held it with --until 2026-10-03, so it asks the captain again that day. Do not hold it again.
To ask sooner, offer the call again with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh offer, or hold it again to move or lift the date.

deferred.words: Unless the battery numbers land first.
deferred.text:
The captain deferred call res-wifi-drop from Bearings until 2027-01-04; bin/fm-captain-hold.sh defer has already held it with --until 2027-01-04, so it asks the captain again that day. Do not hold it again.
To ask sooner, offer the call again with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh offer, or hold it again to move or lift the date.
The captain added words, kept on the call as the captain's reply; nothing has recorded them. Read them before the day comes, since they can change what the deferral means: record an answer with bin/fm-captain-hold.sh answer only if they decide the call, and otherwise answer the captain or ask again. Never infer an answer from the words alone.
The captain said: Unless the battery numbers land first.
